what_this_is: A single person performing by hand, against the same inputs, the work the deployed system does for one supplier across one full lifecycle cycle. The denominator for 'manual steps eliminated'.
caveat: No procurement or compliance practitioner reviewed this step list or the timings. This is a measurement, not a validation, and no claim derived from it may be described as practitioner-validated.
timed_only_note: Certificate uploads and the renewal send were timed up to the button and not executed: both create Communication/File rows that scripts/erp.py cannot see or purge, and a File linked to a Supplier can refuse the Supplier delete.
screening_note: Step 9 was timed against the public OpenSanctions index, not the private synthetic watchlist the system screens: that index has no browser interface (the VM has no external IP and serves a JSON API only). The task is the same, the dataset is not.

steps.description: Read the certificate end to end
steps.navigation: The certificate text is in protocol.md under 'Before you start'. Expiry is 2027-01-01.
https://andina-foods.v.frappe.cloud/app/supplier/new  ->  Details tab  ->  Supplier Name = Empaques Sabana Norte SAS
Same form -> Supplier Group = Distributor (link field: type and pick)
Same form -> Supplier Type = Company (dropdown: Company/Individual/Partnership)
Same form -> Country = Colombia (link field)

steps.description: Create a primary contact and set the email
steps.navigation: Ctrl+S FIRST -- the contact area is hidden until the supplier exists. Then Address & Contact tab -> Contacts -> '+ New Contact' -> First Name 'Sabana Norte', Email 'empaques-sabana-norte-sas@example.com' -> in the contact's Links table add Link Document Type 'Supplier', Link Name 'Empaques Sabana Norte SAS' -> save. Back on the supplier: Primary Address and Contact -> Primary Contact -> pick it -> Ctrl+S. The Links row is what makes the contact visible to the field; without it the dropdown is empty. Email ID is FETCHED and cannot be typed into.
Ctrl+S on the supplier, with the contact now linked.

steps.description: Find and copy the certificate expiry date
steps.navigation: From the certificate text: 2027-01-01

steps.description: Search the supplier name in a sanctions tool
steps.navigation: https://www.opensanctions.org/search/ -> search 'Empaques Sabana Norte SAS'. NOTE: the system screens a private synthetic index with no browser UI, so this step is timed against the PUBLIC index. Same task, different dataset.

steps.description: Read the candidates and judge each near-match
steps.navigation: Decide for each result whether it plausibly refers to your supplier. Record the real time even if there are no hits.
On the Supplier -> bottom timeline -> Comment -> write the decision and why -> save.

steps.description: Attach the certificate to the supplier
steps.navigation: Supplier right sidebar -> Attachments -> Add file -> reach the file dialog -> CANCEL.
https://andina-foods.v.frappe.cloud/app/todo/new -> Due Date 2027-01-01, description naming the supplier -> save.

steps.description: Notice the renewal is due and find the supplier
steps.navigation: https://andina-foods.v.frappe.cloud/app/supplier -> find and open 'Empaques Sabana Norte SAS'
Supplier -> bottom timeline -> New Email -> fill recipient, subject, message asking for the renewed certificate -> then DISCARD. Do not send.
Check the ToDo against the expiry date; nothing has arrived.

steps.description: Put the supplier on hold and choose the hold type
steps.navigation: Supplier -> Settings tab -> 'Block Supplier' section -> tick 'Block Supplier' (this is the on_hold field), Hold Type = All, leave Release Date empty -> Ctrl+S.

steps.description: Read the replacement certificate and find the new expiry
steps.navigation: Second certificate block in protocol.md. New expiry is 2028-01-01.
Sidebar -> Attachments -> Add file -> reach the dialog -> CANCEL.
Supplier -> Settings tab -> untick 'Block Supplier' -> Ctrl+S.
